title: Pro in complete Settings · welcome
expect: Complete production Settings keeps device identity, a separate canonical Pro entry and all existing categories.
Synthetic welcome status opens Pro management; no StoreKit, real account, business gate or onboarding change occurs.
The Pro entry is one stable crown-icon settings row in every access state, with no introduction card or selection-dependent artwork.
Pro detail uses one compact identity, current-access facts when applicable, four explanatory benefit rows on iPhone or five on Mac and a single adjacent plan/purchase section.
Welcome has no subscription renewal facts. The optional offer product price is injected separately; expired access offers a direct paid Subscribe & Continue action.
